ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to 6 months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit clause: up to 6 months of transition assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter. Section 11.3 addresses Confidential Information but says nothing about getting our data back, which we need for continuity of service to our Customers; we can work with 90 days of assistance if 6 months is an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return obligations as new Section 11.4
